moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are in full swing, running until August 2nd, featuring over 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across 11 days of events.

angles.name: General Update
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are lighting up Glasgow! What's been your favourite moment of the Games so far? Still plenty of action to catch before August 2nd! #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Glasgow is absolutely buzzing as the Commonwealth Games continue! So much incredible talent on display right here in Scotland. What events are you following?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Underway

angles.name: Golf Action

angles.name: Lineup Hype
angles.copy: Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, Lily Allen, Kasabian... Boardmasters is bringing the heat to Newquay next week! Get your tickets ready. #Newquay #Festival
